methodology: Eight equally weighted designed workloads. Each H-MEM case learns from a separate prior investigation, then reopens disk memory. Both fixed orders use the same fresh fixtures, runner and evaluator with no history. Best fixed total is selected after measurement, a favorable comparator for rules. Include cleared, switched and missing evidence; do not tune the case mix to claim superiority. No production accuracy, real-model latency, or measured billing claim.

comparison.interpretation: Training cost is additional if prior investigations were run solely to seed memory. A tie or loss is a valid result. Stable recurring blockers can benefit; changed blockers can make the remembered ordering worse.
